title: LETTER 4: Letter to RBI Governor — Suggestion on Digital Lending

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Letters addressed to regulatory heads require an official, analytical, and constructive tone with clearly delineated recommendations.
Digital lending suggestions focus on curbing illegal loan apps, enforcing data minimization, and ensuring transparent interest rate disclosures.
Key regulatory tools discussed include mandatory Key Fact Statements (KFS) and direct disbursement without third-party pool accounts.
Formal letter structure demands standard salutations, a precise subject line, structured arguments, and proper complimentary closing.

blocks.content: A robust regulatory framework for digital lending is essential to protect vulnerable borrowers while fostering responsible fintech innovation.

rows: Direct RE to Borrowers (per RBI Guidelines)

items: Ensure the subject line explicitly mentions the core proposal or suggestion for immediate clarity.
Use standard placeholders (e.g., XYZ, City ABC) for personal identity to adhere to competitive exam evaluation norms.
Highlight specific regulatory mechanisms like Regulated Entities (REs), Lending Service Providers (LSPs), and Grievance Redressal Officers.
